With n1 events (default_flag=1, event='1'), n0 nonevents, P=n1*n0 pairs, N=n1+n0: an event/nonevent pair is concordant when pd_event > pd_nonevent, TIED when |pd_event - pd_nonevent| <= 1e-8 (same fuzz as RULEBOOK A8, an approximation of SAS's ROCEPS grouping; exact equality prints identically on every input), else discordant; Area = (C + T/2)/P (Mann-Whitney); StdErr = DeLong: V10_i = (#nonevents below event i + 0.5*#tied)/n0, V01_j = (#events above nonevent j + 0.5*#tied)/n1, StdErr = sqrt(var(V10, ddof=1)/n1 + var(V01, ddof=1)/n0); LowerArea/UpperArea = Area -/+ 1.959963985*StdErr (95% Wald); SomersD = (C-D)/P; Gamma = (C-D)/(C+D); TauA = (C-D)/(N(N-1)/2). O(N log N) via searchsorted on the sorted nonevent/event scores, never an N1 x N0 matrix. Keep full precision in memory (downstream uses Area).
